title: Oneonta History Centre

services.name: Walking Tours
services.desc: Welcome to this self-guided tour of Main Street Oneonta, part of the Downtown Oneonta Historic District on the New York State and National Registers of Historic Places. We’re proud of our historic downtown, and pleased to share it with you. This is the oldest brick building on Main Street, built in 1866, the year after the railroad came to Oneonta. Through the years the first floor held a hardware store, a restaurant, a dress shop, and a jewelry store. It has been the home of the Greater Oneonta Historical Society since 2005.
